name: DR Congo
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. IDs are TL:<subject>:<measure>:<vintage> and stable across builds: a changed value under the same ID is an upstream revision (recorded in the ledger at /ledger); a new observed year is a new claim. claims.title: Kingdom of Kongo founded
claims.summary: Lukeni lua Nimi establishes the kingdom of Kongo on the lower Congo River, ruling from Mbanza Kongo.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1390-kingdom-of-kongo-founded, claim TL:COD:event:1390:kingdom-of-kongo-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kongo's king baptised as João I
claims.summary: After Diogo Cão's 1483 landfall, King Nzinga a Nkuwu accepts Catholic baptism, taking the name João I and opening close ties with Portugal.

sources.label: Afonso I, king of Kongo kingdom

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1491-kongo-s-king-baptised-as-joao-i, claim TL:COD:event:1491:kongo-s-king-baptised-as-joao-i, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Afonso I protests the slave trade
claims.summary: King Afonso I (Nzinga Mbemba) writes to João III of Portugal complaining that traders are illegally enslaving his subjects, even as the Atlantic trade expands.

sources.label: Afonso I, king of Kongo kingdom
Kingdoms of the Savanna: the Luba and Lunda Empires

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1526-afonso-i-protests-the-slave-trade, claim TL:COD:event:1526:afonso-i-protests-the-slave-trade, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kuba kingdom unified by Shyaam
claims.summary: Shyaam a-Mbul a Ngoong founds the Bushong dynasty, uniting chiefdoms between the Sankuru and Kasai into the Kuba kingdom famed for its art.

sources.label: Kingdoms of the Savanna: the Luba and Lunda Empires

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1625-kuba-kingdom-unified-by-shyaam, claim TL:COD:event:1625:kuba-kingdom-unified-by-shyaam, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Battle of Mbwila breaks Kongo
claims.summary: Portuguese forces defeat Kongo and kill King António I at Mbwila (Ambuila); the kingdom splinters into rival factions and a long civil war.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1665-battle-of-mbwila-breaks-kongo, claim TL:COD:event:1665:battle-of-mbwila-breaks-kongo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Atlantic slave trade at its height
claims.summary: Central African captives are funnelled in vast numbers into the transatlantic trade, hollowing out communities across the lower Congo.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1700-atlantic-slave-trade-at-its-height, claim TL:COD:event:1700:atlantic-slave-trade-at-its-height, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Tippu Tip's eastern slaving state
claims.summary: Swahili-Arab trader Tippu Tip builds a domain around Kasongo in Maniema, raiding the eastern Congo for ivory and slaves.

sources.label: Tippu Tib, African slave trader and explorer

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1869-tippu-tip-s-eastern-slaving-state, claim TL:COD:event:1869:tippu-tip-s-eastern-slaving-state, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Stanley descends the Congo River
claims.summary: Henry Morton Stanley completes the first European traverse of the Congo from interior to the Atlantic, mapping the basin for would-be colonisers.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1877-stanley-descends-the-congo-river, claim TL:COD:event:1877:stanley-descends-the-congo-river, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Leopold hires Stanley for the Congo
claims.summary: King Leopold II commissions Stanley to build stations and obtain treaties from local chiefs, laying the basis for a private colonial claim.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1879-leopold-hires-stanley-for-the-congo, claim TL:COD:event:1879:leopold-hires-stanley-for-the-congo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Congo Free State proclaimed
claims.summary: Following the Berlin Conference, Leopold II establishes the Congo Free State as his personal possession, recognised by the European powers.

sources.label: Leopold II, king of the Belgians

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1885-congo-free-state-proclaimed, claim TL:COD:event:1885:congo-free-state-proclaimed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The rubber regime and the Force Publique
claims.summary: Monopoly decrees and rubber quotas, enforced by the Force Publique through hostage-taking and mutilation, drive a system of forced labour and mass death.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1891-the-rubber-regime-and-the-force-publique, claim TL:COD:event:1891:the-rubber-regime-and-the-force-publique, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Casement Report
claims.summary: British consul Roger Casement publishes a report documenting atrocities; E. D. Morel's Congo Reform Association amplifies the outcry.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1904-the-casement-report, claim TL:COD:event:1904:the-casement-report, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belgium annexes the Belgian Congo
claims.summary: Under international pressure, Belgium takes the territory from Leopold II, ending the Free State and creating the Belgian Congo colony.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1908-belgium-annexes-the-belgian-congo, claim TL:COD:event:1908:belgium-annexes-the-belgian-congo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belgian Congo established
claims.summary: The colony is administered by Belgium for half a century, its economy built on Katangan copper and other minerals.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1908-belgian-congo-established, claim TL:COD:event:1908:belgian-congo-established, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence from Belgium
claims.summary: The Congo becomes independent with Lumumba as prime minister and Kasa-Vubu as president.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1960-independence-from-belgium, claim TL:COD:event:1960:independence-from-belgium, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Katanga secedes; the Congo Crisis
claims.summary: An army mutiny and Moïse Tshombe's Belgian-backed secession of Katanga plunge the new state into crisis and UN intervention.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1960-katanga-secedes-the-congo-crisis, claim TL:COD:event:1960:katanga-secedes-the-congo-crisis, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Assassination of Lumumba
claims.summary: Captured and transferred to Katanga, Patrice Lumumba is killed; Belgian officers were present and foreign involvement is widely documented.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1961-assassination-of-lumumba, claim TL:COD:event:1961:assassination-of-lumumba, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mobutu seizes power
claims.summary: Colonel Joseph-Désiré Mobutu takes full control in a military coup, beginning a three-decade dictatorship.

sources.label: Mobutu Sese Seko, president of Zaire

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1965-mobutu-seizes-power, claim TL:COD:event:1965:mobutu-seizes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Congo renamed Zaire
claims.summary: Under his 'authenticité' campaign, Mobutu renames the country Zaire and adopts the name Mobutu Sese Seko.

sources.label: Mobutu Sese Seko, president of Zaire

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1971-congo-renamed-zaire, claim TL:COD:event:1971:congo-renamed-zaire, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rwandan refugee crisis in the Kivus
claims.summary: The Rwandan genocide drives over a million refugees into eastern Zaire, destabilising the Kivu provinces.

sources.label: Mobutu Sese Seko, president of Zaire

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1994-rwandan-refugee-crisis-in-the-kivus, claim TL:COD:event:1994:rwandan-refugee-crisis-in-the-kivus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First Congo War
claims.summary: A Rwanda- and Uganda-backed rebellion under Laurent-Désiré Kabila advances across the country against the collapsing Mobutu regime.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1996-first-congo-war, claim TL:COD:event:1996:first-congo-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mobutu falls; Kabila takes power
claims.summary: Mobutu flees into exile and dies months later; Kabila seizes Kinshasa and restores the name Democratic Republic of the Congo.

sources.label: Mobutu Sese Seko, president of Zaire

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1997-mobutu-falls-kabila-takes-power, claim TL:COD:event:1997:mobutu-falls-kabila-takes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Second Congo War begins
claims.summary: Kabila breaks with Rwanda and Uganda; nine nations and many militias are drawn into 'Africa's World War,' the deadliest conflict since 1945.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-1998-second-congo-war-begins, claim TL:COD:event:1998:second-congo-war-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Laurent Kabila assassinated
claims.summary: President Laurent-Désiré Kabila is shot dead in Kinshasa; his son Joseph Kabila succeeds him and seeks peace.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-2001-laurent-kabila-assassinated, claim TL:COD:event:2001:laurent-kabila-assassinated, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Peace agreements end the war
claims.summary: The 2002 Sun City and Pretoria accords and a transitional government formally end the Second Congo War in 2003.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-2003-peace-agreements-end-the-war, claim TL:COD:event:2003:peace-agreements-end-the-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: M23 rebellion seizes Goma
claims.summary: The M23 rebel movement briefly captures Goma in North Kivu before being pushed back; conflict festers across the east.

sources.label: The M23 Offensive: Elusive Peace in the Great Lakes

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-2012-m23-rebellion-seizes-goma, claim TL:COD:event:2012:m23-rebellion-seizes-goma, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: M23 retakes Goma
claims.summary: After re-emerging in 2021, M23 — with Rwandan backing — captures Goma again in early 2025, deepening the humanitarian crisis.

sources.label: The M23 Offensive: Elusive Peace in the Great Lakes

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of DR Congo: From the savanna kingdoms to Africa's heart", terralore.co/country/COD/chronicle#ev-2025-m23-retakes-goma, claim TL:COD:event:2025:m23-retakes-goma, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
